evidence: The paper uses a Bayesian Monod-equation regression model as its primary inferential approach, reporting posterior estimates with credible intervals for seed dispersal disruption (−0.38 [−0.46, −0.30]) and other environmental predictors. Random forest was employed only for spatial mapping prevalence; the text states "we developed a random forest model with the 'ranger' packages" to produce Figure 1's map but never reports variable importance metrics from it. Validation includes process-based model comparison, field study consistency checks, and monoculture plantation control analysis showing null effect when mechanism is absent (SI Appendix).
